item.title: Emerging artists making rap, Afrobeats and R&B music push Christian genre boundaries
item.description: A new wave of artists is transcending traditional notions of Christian music, drawing young global audiences to faith-based rap, Afrobeats and R&B.

item.title: Bulgarians pray for bees and bless honey on St. Haralambos Day
item.description: Illuminated by the flickering glow of candlelight, priests approached the tables arranged in the shape of a cross in the middle of a church, enveloped in the heady scent of incense wafting from a censer.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV: Audience appeals for Colombian flood victims, sick & suffering worldwide, European unity
item.description: In Spanish-language remarks to pilgrims and tourists present in the Paul VI Hall for his weekly General Audience on Wednesday morning, the pontiff said he commends “the victims and all those affected by the severe floods in Colombia.”

item.title: Catholics in Colombia bringing relief to thousands affected by floods
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has called for solidarity with the affected, as Colombian authorities say the amount of rain expected for an entire month fell in a single day.

item.title: Conservative Catholic member of Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission ousted in dispute over antisemitism
item.description: A member of the federal Religious Liberty Commission has been ousted after a hearing this week that featured tense exchanges on the definition of antisemitism.

item.title: Bernini and the pope who promoted him celebrated as Vatican marks 400 years of St. Peter’s Basilica
item.description: A new exhibition in Rome is celebrating one of the most important patron-artist relationships in European history, one that propelled a young prodigy named Gian Lorenzo Bernini into a towering figure of Baroque art and architecture.

item.title: US will send troops to Nigeria to train the military to fight extremism
item.description: The United States is sending troops to Nigeria to help train the West African nation's military in fighting extremism, Nigerian authorities said Wednesday, as a multifaceted security crisis spreads in the north of the country.

item.title: Vatican extends olive branch to breakaway SSPX society
item.description: In a bid to stop members of a breakaway traditionalist society from incurring excommunications through the illicit ordination of new bishops, the Vatican has offered a path forward based on theological dialogue.

item.title: During the Winter Games, some Milan churches are teaching Olympic values to thousands of kids
item.description: Olympic podiums are where the world’s best athletes win gold. But dozens of children on Feb. 9 received snowflake-shaped medals of their own in a Milan church a reminder that they, too, are champions in life.

item.title: Filipino priests & religious working to see VP Sara Duterte impeached
item.description: Vice President Sara Duterte, the 47-year-old daughter of former president Rodrigo Duterte, is facing three impeachment complaints, two of which involve Catholic priests and religious sisters among the complainants.
